notes.title: Exploding Heads - Make sure to update tonight!
notes.content: Tonight at midnight central mountain time, i'll post and update! You can expect to see a lot of exploding heads in vs mode, some new tings in the BAC COW KILLA mode and even a few extras in the DRUMPFY RUNNER game. LOVE you all! Can't wait to get some more insults. Eventually this game will be very polished with lots of features and game play modes..but i need some feedback. Let me know how much it sucks, but also what would you like to see? Thnks
